change_summary: Replaced hardcoded grid tuple (triton.cdiv(xnumel, 128), triton.cdiv(ynumel, 8)) with a lambda META grid that uses META['XBLOCK'] and META['YBLOCK'], so the autotuner's selected tile sizes correctly control the CTA count and eliminate the partial-wave tail latency.
